content: शुष्क {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [शुष्-क्त] .²1 Dry, dried up; शाखायां शुष्कं करिष्यामि <ls>Mk. 8</ls>. .²2 Parched up, sear. .²3 Shrivelled, shrunk up, emaciated. .²4 Feigned, pretended, mock; कामिनः स्म कुरुते करभोरूर्हारि शुष्करुदितं च सुखेऽपि <ls>Śi. 10. 69</ls>. .²5 Empty, vain, useless, unproductive; <ls>M. 2</ls>. .²6 Groundless, causeless. .²7 Offensive, harsh; तस्मै नाकुशलं ब्रूयान्न शुष्कां गिरमीरयेत् <ls>Ms. 11. 35</ls>. .{@-ष्कम्@} Anything dry (as wood, cowdung).
